source: 19. What is context compression or selective augmentation, and when can compressing retrieved evidence make the system less reliable? [Advanced] Retrieved passages can be much longer than the evidence actually needed. Context compression tries to keep high-value content while reducing tokens. RECOMP trains extractive or abstractive compressors and can output an empty string when retrieved documents add no useful information, combining compression with selective augmentation. LongLLMLingua compresses long prompts to reduce cost and address information density/position effects. The failure mode is obvious but serious: compression can delete a qualifier, number, negation, exception, or provenance cue that the answer depends on. Abstractive compression can also introduce generation error before the main generator runs. Treat compressed context as a derived representation; retain the original passages for verification and citations, and evaluate answer quality at several compression ratios. Compression is beneficial only if the saved tokens and latency outweigh preprocessing cost and lost evidence. [16][17]
zh: 19. 什么是上下文压缩或选择性增强，压缩检索到的证据何时会降低系统的可靠性？ [高级] 检索到的段落可能比实际需要的证据长得多。上下文压缩试图保留高价值内容，同时减少令牌。 RECOMP 训练提取或抽象压缩器，并在检索到的文档未添加有用信息时输出空字符串，将压缩与选择性增强相结合。 LongLLMLingua 压缩长提示以降低成本并解决信息密度/位置影响。失败模式是明显但严重的：压缩可以删除答案所依赖的限定符、数字、否定、异常或出处提示。抽象压缩还会在主生成器运行之前引入生成错误。将压缩上下文视为派生表示；保留原始段落以进行验证和引用，并在多个压缩比下评估答案质量。仅当节省的令牌和延迟超过预处理成本和丢失的证据时，压缩才是有益的。 [16][17]
